_meta.name: _LITERATURE_ANCHORS
_meta.purpose: Published reference A-score anchors per class AND per cell PLUS sealed VAL evidence base — used by Stage 9 Literature Anchor engine to label customer readings against published cohort data + sealed CPG validation evidence. Used for evidence reports and clinician-facing context.
supersedes_chain: v1.0 (2026-05-28) — original, published anchors only (Lister/De Jager/Shireby/Ceccarelli)
v2.0 DRAFT (2026-06-08) — added VAL evidence, disease benchmarks, pan-cancer cross-cutting, lifestyle, bidirectional decomp, cross-substrate sections
v2_1_additions: New top-level cell_anchors block — anchors keyed by individual cell_type for cell-level lookup
Engine can look up either by class (class_anchors) OR by cell (cell_anchors) — both schemas coexist
Initial cell_anchors coverage: 20 cells with high-priority anchors (mock-report top-15 cells + well-published reference cells from class_anchors)
Per-cell entries include parent_class for back-reference + fall_back_class_anchor for engines needing class-level fallback when cell-specific data is sparse
aging_relevance field per cell captures known age-related behavior (e.g., 'increases with age — inflammaging marker')

Per-cell anchors deliberately sparse in A-score values — most published literature reports cohort or class level, not per-cell. Structure allows incremental population as cell-specific data becomes available.
_meta.engine_integration_note: The class_anchors block (v2.0 format) is preserved unchanged so existing Stage 9 engine continues to read it. The new cell_anchors block is additive — engines can opt in to cell-level lookup. Recommended engine logic: try cell_anchors.{cell_id} first; if not present or sparse, fall back to class_anchors.{parent_class}.

cell_anchors._note: Cell-level anchors keyed by snake_case cell_type_id. Each entry: parent_class for back-reference + class fallback, display_name (clinician-facing), iamatlas_celltype_id_hint (matches the IAMAtlas celltype_markers JSON), aging_relevance (known age-related behavior), fall_back_class_anchor (pointer to class_anchors entry to use when cell-specific data absent), anchors (list of cell-specific reference points). Most cell-specific A-scores are not published in literature — entries reflect this honestly with A: null and source explaining the fallback path. Structure enables incremental population as cell-specific data accrues.

pre_cancer_windows_longest_lead_time.principle: Signal is weakest farthest from clinical presentation — exactly when intervention has most value. Serial sampling captures the architectural drift building toward eventual disease.

treatment_response_monitoring.principle: Pre-treatment baseline vs post-treatment serial samples; cellular response detected before clinical response

recurrence_surveillance.principle: Post-treatment baseline established; drift from that baseline = architectural recurrence signal, often detected before clinical recurrence presents

cross_disease_universal_alarm._note: The v0_1 universal alarm channel — methylation sites that move in coordinated patterns across multiple different diseases. A generalized 'something is wrong' signature.
